title: LinkedIn Recommendation for Emma Wilson
task_prompt:
## task_008: Downstream Candidate -- LinkedIn Recommendation for Emma Wilson

Write a compelling LinkedIn recommendation for Emma Wilson (Product Team) that showcases her strategic impact on Project Beta and the successful Q2 Beta Launch. Structure the recommendation to include: (1) A strong opening hook describing your working relationship and her core product management strengths; (2) 2-3 specific examples of her contributions to Project Beta—such as feature prioritization, user research insights, cross-functional leadership, or technical problem-solving—that directly enabled the Q2 milestone; (3) Quantifiable or qualitative impact from the launch (e.g., user adoption metrics, timeline adherence, team collaboration improvements); (4) Personal qualities that made her effective (communication style, leadership approach, adaptability under pressure); (5) A clear endorsement recommending her for future product roles. Maintain a professional yet authentic tone (150-250 words), use specific product terminology relevant to her expertise, and ensure the voice reflects a colleague who directly collaborated with her during the Q2 launch period.
answer:
I had the opportunity to work closely with Emma Wilson throughout Project Beta and the Q2 launch, and she consistently brought the product judgment, customer focus, and execution discipline that make an exceptional product manager.

Emma was instrumental in turning customer insight into launch-ready decisions. In our user-research synthesis, she helped connect findings from 12 interviews to a simpler onboarding experience—reducing the flow from five steps to three—and kept the team focused on the highest-value improvements. She also played a key role in cross-functional alignment, partnering with Marketing and Sales to translate the product story into clear launch messaging and completing the sales-enablement deck ahead of the April 28 launch. During the final sprints, when the team froze new features and concentrated on critical bugs and performance, Emma kept priorities clear and trade-offs grounded in customer and business impact.

The Q2 Beta Launch landed successfully, on the confirmed timeline, and our broader team velocity improved by 15% in the quarter. Emma’s communication is concise, inclusive, and action-oriented; under pressure, she remains adaptable and brings people together rather than creating noise.

I would recommend Emma without hesitation for any product management role. She combines strategic thinking with excellent execution and would be a tremendous asset to any product organization.
